title: acis orientalis
intro: Acis orientalis, commonly known as Golden Star or Autumn Starflower, is a perennial plant that belongs to the family Amaryllidaceae. The health benefits of Acis orientalis include its potential to support cardiovascular health, improve digestion, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an antispasmodic, expectorant, and diuretic, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Acis orientalis include alkaloids, glycosides, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
